description: State whether the positions you supply conform to the limits and constraints you supply. Calls POST /v1/graph/check and returns the API compliance attestation (attestation de conformité): compliance (compliant or non_compliant), violations, policy_hash, findings, and snapshotId. When issue is true and the API issues an attestation, the result also includes attestation_id, signerAddress, and the verification URL GET /v1/graph/attestation/{id}/verify. This states conformity with your policy. It does not recommend a vault. The same inputs produce the same result for every wallet. No Philidor policy is preselected. A missing or unknown API field is an error, never compliant. A caller without an eligible plan gets a structured refusal (required plan, x402 price, upgrade link), never an empty result. Philidor does not prepare transactions.

agentId.description: Optional caller reference forwarded to the API. Not a wallet and not a key.

constraints.description: Optional rules you set: minTier (Prime, Core, or Edge), allowlist and blacklist (max 1000 vault keys each; a key on both lists is not conforming because the blacklist wins), requireDepositStatus and requireWithdrawStatus (open only), maxFreshnessSeconds (integer 0 to 31622400). Omit the object to add none.

issue.description: When true, ask the API to issue a compliance attestation. Does not prepare a transaction.

limits.description: Exposure caps as fractions in (0, 1]. Pass {} to set none. Omit a field to leave that dimension unconstrained. No Philidor cap is preselected.

positions.description: Positions to check. 1 to 100. This is not a wallet.

amountUsd.description: Position size in USD. Greater than 0.

vaultKey.description: Vault key '{chainId}:{lowercase 0x address}', for example 1:0xabc... with 40 hex digits.

name: check_policy
